liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Little Red Rooster** (2 reviews): Brent scatting during this track is highlighted as a best version by the listener; The solo from 4:40 to 4:55 is described as straight up nasty and prime [11][21]
- **Saint of Circumstance** (1 review): Bobby's vocal improvisations become increasingly wacky during the chorus of this song [10]
- **(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction** (1 review): Bobby riles the crowd with non-sequitur ad-libs like "You're gonna burn" before the end [10]
- **// Alabama Getaway** (1 review): Jerry forgot the words midway, but the band jammed it out nicely as the opener [13]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The band broke out the China/Rider set closer, surprising listeners expecting a break [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-05-17.143036.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 174 min [1]
- **gd1981-05-17.139961.fob.senn421.streeter.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 26 songs; 179 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1981-05-17.aud.munder.9000.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 26 songs; 173 min; rated 4.17/5 by 12 [4]. Said about its sound: A brief drop-out occurs at 58 seconds into Alabama Getaway, cutting back during the intro [4]
- **gd1981-05-17.143035.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 174 min [2]

## Around the show

- The band's sudden start with Alabama Getaway caught the audience and tapers off-guard [13]
- A friend attending Hartwick College called it one of the best shows he had seen [14]
- The venue is historically accurate as the Onondaga County War Memorial Auditorium [17]
- A ticket taker admitted the reviewer and brother despite one ticket being invalid [19]
- The reviewer taped a deck to her leg under her skirt while dancing [20]
- The reviewer prefers this first set over the previous night's performance at Cornell [11]
- The performance is compared to Warfield 1983-03-31, noting similar style but missing scat [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-05-17.143036.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Jim Wise's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII-C90)(located at the soundboard); Transfer Info: Master… [1]. Also: The nak300 source supplies the crowd and the first five seconds of Alabama Getaway [1]
- **gd1981-05-17.139961.fob.senn421.streeter.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Frank Streeter; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Source Info: Frank Streeter's Master FOB Audience Cassette; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5M (TDK MA90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) >… [3]. Also: The nak300 source supplies tuning, the start of Alabama Getaway, and a patch in Drums [3]
- **gd1981-05-17.aud.munder.9000.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD > (?) > MC > Soundforge > CDR [4]
- **gd1981-05-17.143035.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Jim Wise's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII-C90)(located at the soundboard); Transfer Info: Master Cassettes… [2]
